name: Zhejiang Dongri Limited Company
summary: Founded in 1997 and headquartered in Wenzhou, China, Zhejiang Dongri Limited Company operates across several key industries. The firm primarily focuses on the marketing of lighting products and the wholesale distribution of agricultural commodities. Its extensive operations also include the production of industrial gases, the supply chain management for agricultural and sideline products, various transportation services, and financial investment undertakings.
